title: Stigmata man at a UFO conference

tellings.quote: And one guy had the stigmata.

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the National Security Agency (the US government's electronic spying agency) once hired him to communicate with aliens, recalls meeting a man at a UFO conference who had the stigmata. Stigmata are wounds on the body like the wounds of the crucified Christ. Sherman says he saw this himself, as part of describing the unusual people he met at such gatherings.
